name: gizza-ai/qr-decode
summary: Decode the data in a QR code image.

tool.description: Read and decode the data contained in a QR code image (PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/WebP). Returns the decoded text of every QR code found in the image, in detection order. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Runs locally — the image never leaves the device.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
